cards.text: Paul is wrapping up his letter to the believers in Colossae (Colossians 1:2), and friend, we've hit the part where EVERYBODY wants in. It's the birthday card passed around the office, and every single person squeezes in a hello. First up is Tychicus, a brother Paul is sending their way.

cards.question: Paul is sending Tychicus to the Colossians. What's Tychicus going to tell them?
News isn't the only reason for the trip. Paul sends Tychicus to the Colossians so he may ___ their hearts.

cards.text: Tychicus isn't coming alone: Paul sends Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother who's one of the Colossians' own, and together they'll tell the Colossians everything going on where Paul is. Before group chats, THIS was the group chat, and it knocked on your door.

The first greeting comes from Aristarchus, Paul's fellow prisoner, so this man is a PRISONER and he STILL sends a hello. When I got stuck in the back of a junk drawer, I wouldn't even say hi to the rubber bands.

cards.question: Mark sends greetings too. He's the cousin of Barnabas, who once traveled with Paul (Acts 13:2-4), and the Colossians already have instructions about Mark. What are they?

cards.text: One more greeting comes from Jesus, who is called Justus, a different man from Jesus Christ. Paul says Aristarchus, Mark and Justus are the only Jews among his fellow workers for the kingdom of God.

cards.question: Paul says Aristarchus, Mark and Justus have been a worry to him.

cards.text: Next greeting comes from Epaphras, a servant of Christ Jesus, and just like Onesimus, he's one of the Colossians. He's always WRESTLING in prayer for them, and that's no quick prayer on the way out the door, friend, that's a man ON THE MAT.

cards.question: Epaphras is always wrestling in prayer for the Colossians. What does he pray for them?

answers.text: To stand mature in God's will
To stay safe from all trouble

cards.text: Epaphras goes to great pains for the Colossians and for the folks in Laodicea and Hierapolis too, so this man is covering THREE towns and I can barely cover one oven. Then Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas send greetings.

Then Paul tells the Colossians to greet the brothers in Laodicea, and Nympha and the church that meets at her house. A whole CHURCH in her house, and I panic when ONE baker sees my flour-covered counter.

cards.question: Paul gives orders about this very letter. Once the Colossians have read it, what does he want done with it?

answers.text: Have it read in another church
Keep it safe with the elders

cards.question: Paul tells the Colossians to skip the letter from Laodicea.
Paul has the Colossians pass a message to a man named Archippus about the ministry he received in the Lord. What does Paul tell him?

answers.text: Rest from it for a while

cards.text: That's a sticky note on your monitor that just says FINISH THE THING. Then Paul takes the pen himself and writes this greeting in his own hand.

cards.question: In his own hand, Paul asks the Colossians to remember his chains.

cards.text: And his very last words: “Grace be with you.” Not some sign-off you'd stick at the bottom of an email, just GRACE, and I am stealing that for every cookie box I seal.
